answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can work like a tended garden rather than an open canyon: every agent must earn reputation through verifiable work before it can transact, the way a falcon proves itself by hunting, not by claiming feathers. Require small refundable stake deposits that grow with each attested task, and let peers rate completed work on-chain — cheap fake identities cannot afford the stake and have no history, so they stay at the edge while proven agents trade freely.
